```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align='center', echo = TRUE)
options(scipen=5)

suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(segmented)
  library(tidyr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ChIPpeakAnno)
  library(ChIPseeker)
  library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)

}))

source(params$configFile)
```

```{r}
## Collate peak sets called with stringent thresholds

peakFiles <- list.files(
  path = peaksCurated,
  pattern = "narrowPeak\\.filt$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

peakFiles <- peakFiles[!grepl("\\.sorted\\.noSC\\.narrowPeak\\.filt$", peakFiles)]

peaks<-list()
for(each in peakFiles){
  fraction<-head(unlist(strsplit(each, "\\.")), n = 1)
  peaks[[fraction]]<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(read.table(each), keep.extra.columns=TRUE, seqnames.field="V1",
                                              start.field="V2",
                                              end.field="V3",
                                              ignore.strand=TRUE)
}

names(peaks) <- gsub(peaksCurated, "",names(peaks))
peaks.df <- data.frame(name = names(peaks)) %>%
  separate(
    name,
    into = c("empty", "cell_type", "peak_set_name"),
    sep = "/",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-empty)

peaks.df$n_peaks <- sapply(peaks, length)

```

## Overview

Peak calling was performed using only samples that passed all the PIPPA QC stages: sequencing quality, sample identity and correct cell type. These samples were used for peak calling with a relaxed threshold and then the user picked a stringent threshold through the segmented analysis (STEPs 9.3-5). Here, we explore the properties of the peak sets generated with stringent thresholds using MACS3 for each cell type. All peak sets generated will be shown here.

### 1. Number of peaks

First, we will look at the number of peaks called for each curated peak set generated.

```{r}
  
p1 <- ggplot(peaks.df, aes(x = peak_set_name,y = n_peaks,fill = cell_type,)) +
  geom_col(linewidth = 0.7,width = 0.8,color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_vals_plots) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Peak Set",
    y = "Number of Peaks", fill = "Cell type"
  ) + theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title =  element_text(
      face = "bold",size = 15,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 10
    ),
    legend.position = "none")
p1
```

### 2. Width of peaks

```{r}
extract_widths <- function(gr_list) {
  
  bind_rows(
    
    lapply(names(gr_list), function(nm) {
      
      gr <- gr_list[[nm]]
      
      widths <- width(gr)
      widths[widths > 10000] <- 10000
      
      data.frame(
        PeakSet = nm,
        cell_type = sub("^/([^/]+)/.*$", "\\1", nm),
        peak_set_name = sub("^/[^/]+/(.*)$", "\\1", nm),
        Width = widths
      )
      
    })
  )
}

widths_peaks <- extract_widths(
  peaks
)

p2 <- ggplot(widths_peaks,aes(x = Width,y = peak_set_name,fill = cell_type))+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.65,outlier.shape = NA,linewidth = 0.8,color = "black") +
  stat_summary( fun = median,geom = "point", size = 2.5,color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_vals_plots) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,quantile(widths_peaks$Width, 0.99) ))+
  labs(x = "Peak width (bp)",y = NULL,fill = "Cell type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
     axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
     legend.position = "none"
    )
p2
```

### 3. Gaps between peaks

```{r}
extract_peak_gaps <- function(gr_list) {
  
  bind_rows(
    
    lapply(names(gr_list), function(nm) {
      
      gr <- gr_list[[nm]]
      gr <- sort(gr)
      gap_gr <- gaps(gr)
      gap_widths <- width(gap_gr)
      gap_widths <- gap_widths[
        is.finite(gap_widths) &
          gap_widths > 0
      ]
      
      data.frame(
        
        PeakSet = nm,
        GapWidth = gap_widths,
        
        cell_type = sub("^/([^/]+)/.*$", "\\1", nm),
        peak_set_name = sub("^/[^/]+/(.*)$", "\\1", nm)
        )
    })
  )
}

gaps_peaks <- extract_peak_gaps(
  peaks
)

p3 <- ggplot(gaps_peaks,aes(x = GapWidth,y = peak_set_name,fill = cell_type))+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.65,outlier.shape = NA,linewidth = 0.8,color = "black") +
  stat_summary( fun = median,geom = "point", size = 2.5,color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_vals_plots) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,quantile(gaps_peaks$GapWidth, 0.90) ))+
  labs(x = "between peaks (bp)",y = NULL,fill = "Cell type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
     axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
     legend.position = "none"
    )
p3
```

### 4.Genomic annotation of peaks

```{r}
peaksAnno.all<-lapply(peaks,annotatePeak,
                      TxDb=TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene, 
                      annoDb="org.Hs.eg.db", verbose = FALSE)
names(peaksAnno.all) <- names(peaks)

changeAnnotation <- function(df_sub){
  annotation_df <- df_sub %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      annotation_group = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("Promoter", annotation) ~ "Promoter",
        grepl("Exon", annotation) ~ "Exon",
        grepl("Intron", annotation) ~ "Intron",
        TRUE ~ "Intergenic"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(annotation_group) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      annotation_n = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      percent = annotation_n / sum(annotation_n) * 100
    )
}

peaksAnno.df <- lapply(peaksAnno.all, function(x) as.data.frame(x@anno))
peaksAnno.df.anno <- lapply(peaksAnno.df, changeAnnotation)

combined <- bind_rows(
  peaksAnno.df.anno,
  .id = "peak_set_name"
)

combined$cell_type = sub("^/([^/]+)/.*$", "\\1", combined$peak_set_name)
combined$peak_set_name = sub("^/[^/]+/(.*)$", "\\1", combined$peak_set_name)

p4 <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = peak_set_name, y = percent, fill = annotation_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",width = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "% Peaks",
    fill = "Annotation"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~cell_type,scales = "free")+
  coord_flip()+ 
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = 15,hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
p4
```
